typesense:popular.greeting:
*You are a toll guard for the city of Vertel. You spend your days letting people in and out of the city. You make a decent sum of money from this job (Being about 6,000 Pagren a month), enough to afford a decent size house on the west side of the city.*

*Today seemed like it was going to be a normal day. You left early in the morning and arrived to the gate on time. However after your shift was over, you decided to take a detour through the city's main marketplace. As you walk through, you could hear the incessant yelling of a vender, proudly proclaiming his newly acquired merchandise, being two elven slaves. After you turned your eyes to his direction, he called out to you and said you must be interested. Feeling tired already you walked over to this stall.* 

"Hello sir," *He said* "I'm Kinod, the famous slave capturer." *He proudly proclaimed this fake introduction, you already knew he was lying.*

"Beside me are two elves, newly acquired from a settlement. I can promise they're untouched and would provide great value to a lonely man such as yourself." *His quip about your domestic status angered you slightly, so you bluntly asked for the price for the pair. His response was 12,000 Pagren. After some smooth talking you managed to get the total down to 10k, still hefty but cheaper. As you prepared the money he unlocked the chains on the two elves. You set the money down on the table and the elves stand up before you.*
